strings.EVT_BATTLE_BREAKTHROUGH_DESC:
Vanguard formations along the '{axis_name}' axis have shattered enemy forward positions. Hostile lines are collapsing into disarray.

Headquarters requests authorization for immediate exploitation.
strings.EVT_BATTLE_BREAKTHROUGH_OPT1: Exploit with deep armored spearhead (-1500 rifles, +20% progress)
strings.EVT_BATTLE_BREAKTHROUGH_OPT2: Consolidate defensive perimeter and bring up artillery (+5 readiness)
strings.EVT_BATTLE_ENCIRCLEMENT_DESC:
Forward battalions along the '{axis_name}' spearhead have outrun logistics and suffered a violent flank counter-attack. Immediate pocket encirclement is imminent!

Urgent command decisions required.
strings.EVT_BATTLE_ENCIRCLEMENT_OPT1: Hold at all costs! Stand firm! (-2500 troops, +2 legitimacy)
strings.EVT_BATTLE_ENCIRCLEMENT_OPT2: Orderly withdrawal to defensive rallying lines (-10% progress)
strings.RAID_DEFICIT_WEAPONS: Raid aborted: critical deficit of small arms in arsenals!
strings.RAID_SUCCESS_SUMMARY: Raid victorious! Captured ${cash} B spoils, {weapons} firearms, {manpower} captives. Friendly losses: {losses} personnel.
strings.RAID_FAILURE_SUMMARY: Raiding vanguard met fortified resistance and withdrew with casualties ({losses} personnel).
strings.FRONT_BREAKTHROUGH_SUMMARY: FRONT BREAKTHROUGH! Axis [{axis_name}] crushed hostile defense and secured region #{region_id} ({region_name})! Enemy losses: {enemy_losses}.
strings.ECON_AUSTERITY_ON_MSG: AUSTERITY REGIME ACTIVATED: Military and civilian spending curtailed, revenue enforced, public unrest rising.
strings.ECON_AUSTERITY_OFF_MSG: AUSTERITY REGIME LIFTED: Sector allocations restored to standard appropriations.
strings.ECON_CURRENCY_REFORM_FAIL_MSG: Denied: Insufficient liquid reserves to back new legal tender (requires ${required} B).
strings.ECON_CURRENCY_REFORM_SUCCESS_MSG: CURRENCY REFORM SUCCESSFUL: Aggressive demonetization slashed inflation by 55% and stabilized the currency.
strings.ECON_PROVINCE_NOT_FOUND: Province not found in world registry.
strings.ECON_PROVINCE_NOT_OWNED: Province is not under sovereign control.
strings.ECON_FISCAL_CRISIS_BLOCK: Fiscal Crisis: Treasury depleted, international credit lines revoked.
strings.ECON_PROSPECT_SUCCESS: Geological survey complete: discovered new deposits in {name} ({resource} +{amount})!
strings.DIR_ERR_BRANCH_DISALLOWED: Directive branch locked by current political conditions (allow_branch).
strings.DIR_ERR_INSUFFICIENT_CAP: Insufficient Cabinet Action Points (CAP): required {req}, available {cur}.
strings.DIR_ERR_MUTUALLY_LOCKED: Directive locked by state leadership decision: {id}
